title: Matched variants reported in gastric cancer and lesion progression studies (2026)
description: Independent tag variants from GIM loci cross-referenced with published gastric cancer GWAS and lesion progression literature.
note:
Note: The table summarizes genetic variants that have been previously reported to be associated with GC or gastric lesion progression in published GWAS. Reported variants were identified through systematic referencing of lead variants prioritized in the present study with publicly available GWAS findings and curated literature. The functional annotation scores include the CADD score, where higher values indicate greater predicted deleteriousness, and the RegulomeDB score, where lower scores (ranging from 1a to 7) denote stronger evidence for regulatory potential. The columns K to N list published studies in which the variant was previously associated with GC or gastric lesion progression. Detailed information for each matched study is provided in the corresponding columns. Variants may have available evidence from one study or multiple studies across different populations and study designs.

Abbreviation: CADD, combined annotation dependent depletion; GC, gastric cancer; GWAS, genome-wide association analyses.
